decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless covered by approved mitigation.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
A compliant certification decision must be supported by admissible evidence showing those predicates are already met, not merely recommended or anticipated.
